text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian newspapers this morning.
-Doctors and public health sector employees say they will refuse to moderate demands in this year's wage negotiations.
-The official county doctor in Norway's most northern county, Finnmark, has asked autorithies to improve alert measures in case of nuclear accidents.

-Four Norwegian companies are short listed to produce plans for getting rid of Shell's Brent Spar oil rig. Brent Spar is moored in a Norwegian fjord and Shell hopes that decommisioning can get underway in early 1998.

-Oil companies are expected to fiercely contest a battle for assets on the Norwegian continental shelf offered by Den norske stats oljeselskap (Statoil) as part of a restructuring program of its core activities.

- Recent comments by Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg has increased demand for the Norwegian crown, bond market analysts say. The crown rose a further one percent against the European Currency Unit on Monday.
